Chromatic Button v0.1.0 from ReactDrops (https://reactdrops.dev/components/button/chromatic-button),
added from https://reactdrops.dev/r/chromatic-button.json. Licensed under the ReactDrops Component
License 1.0 (LICENSE.txt in this folder): free to use in this site, not to be redistributed as a
reusable component.

No local changes. The site uses only `ChromaticSurface` (the WebGL chrome material) inside the drop
field's round upload button, with the button's material settings copied from `chromaticButtonDefaults`
(see ChromeOrb.tsx). chromatic-button.tsx and .css are kept as received but are not bundled.
